name: Arctic Blue Beverages AB (publ)
summary: Founded in 2017 and based in Stockholm, Sweden, Arctic Blue Beverages AB (publ) manufactures and markets a selection of artisanal drinks internationally, with a presence in countries like Finland, Sweden, Canada, Japan, and Australia. The company's diverse product range, offered under the ARCTIC BLUE brand, includes various types of gin (such as Navy Strength, Rose, Cask Vintage, and Laku), oat-based beverages, long drinks, tonic water, and ready-to-drink cocktails. These offerings are distributed through a network of partners.
